description: This file defines the ConditionalFormatting class which provides static methods to retrieve string representations of conditional formatting types and operators based on integer codes within the PHPSpreadsheet library's XLS reader component.

classes.name: ConditionalFormatting
classes.description: A utility class providing mappings between numeric codes and string descriptions of conditional formatting types and operators for XLS files.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the string description of a conditional formatting type based on its integer code, or null if unknown.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string description of a conditional operator based on its integer code, or null if unknown.
